title: Spreading a finite separable extension over a localization
statement: Let A be a Noetherian integral domain with fraction field K and let K'/K be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] that is finite-dimensional as a K-vector space [def-weil-vector-space-dimension] and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. There is a nonzero c in A and a finite etale A[c^{-1}]-algebra A' [def-weil-etale-morphism] that is a domain with fraction field K'; consequently Spec(A') to Spec(A[c^{-1}]) is finite etale and surjective.

source.place: proof, finite-algebra calculation, spreading out the separable extension

proof.text: Choose a primitive element alpha using Field.exists_primitive_element. Apply the proved localized-separable-polynomial model to descend its minimal polynomial and a Bezout identity to S=A[1/c] inside L.

Construct B=S[alpha]. The evaluation map AdjoinRoot f to B is surjective by adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval; injectivity follows from minpoly.dvd after mapping coefficients into K, and monic map_dvd_map. Transfer finite generation from the monic AdjoinRoot. For the fraction field, lift Frac(B) into L and view its field range as an intermediate field containing K and alpha; primitivity makes it all of L.

Use the Bezout identity to define the standard-etale pair (f,1), whose algebra is the localization of AdjoinRoot f at 1. This is AdjoinRoot f itself, so transfer etaleness to B. The finite and etale Spec characterizations give the geometric clauses. The subalgebra map S to B is injective, and finite implies integral, so lying-over makes the spectrum map surjective.

lean.statement: theorem exists_spread_finite_separable_extension (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] (L : Type w) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] : ∃ c : A, c ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ S : Subalgebra A L, IsLocalization.Away c S ∧ ∃ B : Subalgebra S L, Module.Finite S B ∧ Algebra.Etale S B ∧ IsFractionRing B L ∧ IsFinite (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S B))) ∧ Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S B))) ∧ Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S B)))
